overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated YouTube Shorts performance indicates massive viewer traction for 'What If' space scenarios and extreme planetary facts (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y with 1024 views/38 likes, 8KEl0_pJ_68 with 972 views, and A9Qa-RmuOr0 with 509 views). Space/Astronomy hooks utilizing counter-intuitive conditions ('What If you fell into...', extreme environments) heavily outperform standard biology facts or static historical trivia in views-per-day and engagement (likes-per-view).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos testing hypothetical drops into extreme planetary bodies (IYuce8vaU3Y, 8KEl0_pJ_68, 6pwazIPnOHw) consistently achieve the highest view counts and like-to-view ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space disaster/immersion scenarios using 'What If You Fell Into...' as the core hook structure.

winning_patterns.evidence: Shorts highlighting extreme planetary anomalies like time distortion or rare rain compositions (A9Qa-RmuOr0, QXuqYERlqSo, v1rrcZLdp4U) generate rapid initial velocity and steady engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on rare, visually striking astronomical phenomena with mind-bending statistics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like song memory loops and fake memories (ef3ND4qiRHc, 5AN7LUgqarc, 2fqaGqfsR4A) show low view velocities and minimal comments.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological and memory-based hacks unless tied to a high-stakes survival or sci-fi narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Standard animal trivia without high-stakes framing (e.g., basic multi-heart or lifespan facts like F1kXwuXuNgo) stall quickly under 100 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content exclusively toward cinematic animal survival or extreme prehistoric comparisons rather than standard listicle facts.
